newsitem.title: USA: ENStar Q1 hurt by weak networking demand.
newsitem.headline: ENStar Q1 hurt by weak networking demand.

text.p: ENStar Inc said its first-quarter loss reflects a falloff in demand from two significant customers at its Americable Inc subsidiary which provides networking and connectivity products and cable assemblies.
In addition, it said operating results were hurt by the slowdown experienced by many networking companies during the quarter.
ENStar posted a quarterly loss of $0.18 per share compared to a year-ago profit of $0.10 per share.

President Jeffrey Michael also noted that the company was expanding its Enstar Networking Corp's service programs. "Our first-quarter results reflect approximately $300,000 of marketing and other related costs associated with organizational changes."
